dict.string: Sayso sets alarms and timers when you ask it to, so they ring like any other alarm on your iPhone.
Sayso reads your calendar to show your day, answer questions about it, change or cancel events when you ask, and plan your day around them. Your calendar stays on your iPhone.
Sayso adds events to your calendar when you ask it to. It can only add events, not read your existing ones.
Sayso uses the camera to photograph a menu. The photo is read on your iPhone and is never saved or uploaded.
Sayso looks up the person you name so it can address your message or email. Contacts stay on your iPhone.
Sayso listens only while you hold the mic button, to turn what you say into text. Audio is processed on your iPhone and never leaves it.
Sayso creates reminders when you ask it to, and checks the ones due today when planning your day.
Sayso converts your speech to text on your iPhone so it can understand your request. Nothing is sent to a server.
